Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to execute the critical step of verifying the edit history. Instead of checking the actual revision history of the "Dragon" Wikipedia page to find a specific edit made on a leap day before 2008, the agent hallucinated a specific phrase ("Not to be confused with Dragon lizard...") as the removed joke. This phrase is currently visible on the page (as seen in subsequent turns), meaning it was not removed; the agent incorrectly assumed the presence of a standard disambiguation note constituted a "joke removed on a leap day" without any factual basis or evidence from the edit history.
